goalTranslation.businessGoal: User-delegated research, chat, and desktop tasks complete autonomously without unbounded loops, unsafe writes, or silent tool failures

quantifiedTarget.rationale: HEALTH_CONFIG.errorRateCritical in backend/convex/config/autonomousConfig.ts — 5% error rate marks a component critical

decomposition: route intent and model tier (workers/node/nemoclaw/agentRunner.ts classifyIntent)
tool-calling loop bounded by maxTurns with per-tool circuit breaker
synthesis nudge near turn limit, forced synthesis at limit
sensitive tools suspend for human approval (backend/convex/domains/agents/hitl/config.ts)

tiers.action: read-only tools (screenshot, read_file, search_code, git_status, project_structure)

interception.how: sanitizeErrorMessage in workers/node/nemoclaw/agentRunner.ts — stable error class from retryPolicy.classifyError, secret redaction, stack stripping, 240-char bound — applied before errors enter conversationHistory or are rethrown; auditLog.sanitizeArgs redacts secrets in audit trail

fallback.description: retryPolicy.ts returns a dead_letter verdict with deterministic fingerprint after exhausted retries; DLQ groups identical failures for human review

slos.rationale: ASPIRATIONAL — no enforced completion-rate target exists in code yet; declared at the vacuous floor rather than inventing a number. See production-agent.notes.md

circuitBreaker.onTrip: health monitor marks component critical (autonomousConfig.ts, 5-min health-check cadence); in-loop breaker in agentRunner.ts force-synthesizes a final answer after any single tool is called 3 times

costFuse.onTrip: voice session refused when dailyCostUsd >= dailyCapUsd (workers/node/agents/realtimeVoicePolicy.ts, DEFAULT_VOICE_DAILY_CAP_USD = 5). VOICE LANE ONLY — there is no global cost fuse; see production-agent.notes.md

judgeRegression.command: npx tsx scripts/eval-harness/runner.ts --list (.github/workflows/convex-mcp-eval-gate.yml; nightly cron 0 4 * * * runs the full suite with real agent invocation)
